sources.title: Immigration raids leave crops unharvested, California farms at risk

supported_event_claim: Reuters reported Ventura County farm raids and quoted a farmer estimating 70% of local field workers were absent.
reason: The 70% number is an interviewee's estimate, not an independently measured countywide share.

sources.title: How It Happened: Timeline of Immigration Raid in Carpinteria

supported_event_claim: Federal agents raided a Carpinteria farm on July 10 and deployed crowd-control munitions near protesters.
reason: Original local reporting reviewed footage of the specific raid and munitions, without proving all personnel were military.

sources.title: Utah man wrongfully detained by ICE for nearly 50 days, attorney says

supported_event_claim: Lawful permanent resident Junior Dioses was detained in immigration custody for nearly 50 days, according to his attorney.
reason: KSL reports the detention and attributes the allegation of wrongful treatment to the attorney.

sources.title: Lawyers say Alabama father deported to Laos despite court order blocking removal

supported_event_claim: Lawyers said Chanthila Souvannarath was deported to Laos despite a court order while asserting a citizenship claim.
reason: AP documents counsel's claims about the court order and citizenship without independently adjudicating either.

sources.title: US immigration agent fatally shoots woman in Minneapolis

supported_event_claim: A federal immigration agent fatally shot a woman in Minneapolis on January 7, 2026.
reason: Reuters documents the shooting and notes disputed accounts about the circumstances.
